method: Only owner-supplied PDFs and existing Git references. Original scanned pages read visually; corrected/full 2025 documents checked by text and table/formula renderings. No web copies. Human independent transcription and building applicability review remain pending.

comparison.finding: No numerical difference found in the selected flat-terrain S1, recovered S2 exposure/Fr data, group3 S3, Vk, q and density; existing original-edition speed implementation retained. This is not a whole-standard equivalence claim.
Original explicitly says category II always; corrected wording omits that phrase. Table2 global numerical factors unchanged. No new category-dependent factor invented.

Six negative original entries become positive, with same magnitude. Confirmed: h/b<=1/2 theta45/60; 1/2<h/b<=3/2 theta45/60; 3/2<h/b<=6 theta50/60. Only theta45 h/b<=1/2 is admitted by the current implementation.

comparison.item: Tables7,8 geometry; Table8 theta30 global Ce
comparison.finding: Selected zone geometry and mono theta30 global coefficients unchanged in compared pages. Eaves h is distinct from maximum speed reference height. Local cpe medio is not substituted for primary-structure Ce.
Original reference points to Table4; corrected reference points to Table6. Dominant openings remain blocked; this comparison does not implement that procedure.

Compared simplified opposite/four-face and airtight internal-pressure alternatives unchanged numerically. Only airtight fixed-window 6.3.2.2 implemented, retaining both internal alternatives. Equal permeability is not inferred from gross geometry.

implementedSubset.wind: Primary global roof Ce; square plan a=b, b=+X, a=+Y; width-positive fall; no overhangs/projections/lanterns; gable theta45, eaves h/b<=0.5, alpha0/90; mono theta30, low-eaves h/b<2, alpha90/270; declared airtight fixed windows, negligible accidental breakage, one pressure volume, no separate ceiling pressure, no neighbor amplification, static T<=1s, classA dimensions<=20m, group3 S3. Existing speed provider requires flat uniform terrain.
implementedSubset.combinations: NBR8681:2025 5.1.2.3, 5.1.3.1, 5.1.4.1-.4, 5.1.5.2-.4; Tables1,4,6: individual steel self-weight or industrialized-roof G, roof-use Q, wind principal/accompanying; normal ULS and rare/frequent/quasi-permanent SLS. Wire SLS-characteristic means 2025 rare (accompanying psi1). Whole permanent action has one gamma; favorable variable actions omitted whole; all wind alternatives exclusive.
